paper.title: A cellular automaton model for freeway traffic

headline: Nagel-Schreckenberg 1992 (agent-based): 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; fundamental-diagram flow peaks at rho=0.1 (interior; canonical rho_c~0.1)

verdicts.gate: P1 fundamental diagram has an interior flow maximum (argmax rho not at the density endpoints; canonical rho_c~0.1)
P2 free-flow at low density, congested at high (mean v >= 3 at rho=0.05 AND mean v <= 2 at rho=0.5)
P3 spontaneous jams emerge (stopped-car fraction v=0 >= 0.1 at rho=0.5, no obstacle)

extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce the fundamental diagram (interior flow maximum, free-flow->jam transition, spontaneous jams) and would catch an artifact

citations: Nagel, K., Schreckenberg, M. (1992). A cellular automaton model for freeway traffic. Journal de Physique I 2(12):2221-2229. doi:10.1051/jp1:1992277.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction
